subject: Pulse plan: TPM ramp & MAP draft for ScoutAI
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@scoutai.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Pulse plan: TPM ramp & MAP draft for ScoutAI

Hi Liam —

Great talking yesterday. Attached is a lightweight Mutual Action Plan (MAP) draft (ScoutAI_MAP_v3.docx) and the Q3 usage projection workbook. The goal here is to lock in a pragmatic ramp so you can run a representative evaluation while giving ScoutAI predictable economics if you choose to commit. Key items in the draft: 

- Evaluation window: 45 days, with health-check at day 14 and day 30.
- Pilot commitments: month 1 = 100M tokens (TPM), month 2 = 250M TPM, month 3 onward = run-rate 1.2B TPM (staggered growth).
- Pricing: hosted list price with a 15% volume discount once quarterly commit >= 3.6B tokens.
- Ramp credits: 10% implementation credit applied to month 1 invoice if ScoutAI signs before Sept 15.
- SLA exception: we can include a limited SLA carve-out during evaluation; see SLA_exception_request.pdf.

Questions for you: are the month-by-month TPM targets compatible with your forecast? Does the 15% discount trigger line up with your procurement expectations? And what close timing would you need to hit the implementation credit?

If that looks directionally right, I’ll circulate a clean MAP and a redline-ready Spot vs Commit comparison for Ben and Karthik to sign off on.

Thanks —
Naomi Feldman
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0176

Attachments: ScoutAI_MAP_v3.docx, usage_projection_Q3.xlsx

From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@scoutai.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Ellen Park <ellen.park@scoutai.com>, Procurement <procurement@scoutai.com>
Date: Wed, 26 Aug 2026 11:02:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Pulse plan: TPM ramp & MAP draft for ScoutAI

Naomi —

Thanks for the quick draft and the projection workbook. High level: we like the staged approach, but Procurement will want a slightly lower threshold on the discount trigger and a clearer overage rate post-commit. A few specific asks: 

1) Can the discount tier be 12% at 2.5B quarterly and 18% at 4.5B? That lets us choose the lower-risk ramp but still get meaningful price relief.
2) Overage: can we cap overage price at list - 5% for months 4–6 if we miss the run-rate?
3) Close timing: if we sign a MAP by Sept 10 we can budget to honor the month-1 credit, otherwise we need it pushed to Oct.

One operational note — our engineering team will need a KV-cache warmup guide and a short onboarding window (2 weeks) to hit those TPM numbers; please add that into the MAP timeline.

Attaching procurement contact for contracting follow-up.

Regards,
Liam O'Connor
Director of Platform, ScoutAI
liam.oconnor@scoutai.com

Date: Thu, 27 Aug 2026 08:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pulse plan: TPM ramp & MAP draft for ScoutAI

Liam —

Really helpful feedback, thanks. Quick responses inline: 

1) Discount tiers: we can accept your two-tier ask (12% @ 2.5B qtr, 18% @ 4.5B qtr). I’ve updated the MAP to show both a baseline and an accelerated path.
2) Overage cap: we can cap overage at list - 5% for months 4–6 as a one-time concession if the MAP is signed by Sept 10. After month 6, standard overage policy applies.
3) Close timing & credit: Sept 10 is fine — implementation credit (10% month-1) will be applied if DocuSign is completed by then.
4) Onboarding: adding a 2-week technical onboarding milestone (Day 0–14) and adding a KV-cache warmup checklist to the MAP under "Operational Milestones."

Ben / Karthik / Marissa — can you review the updated commercial levers: the two-tier discount, the temporary overage cap, and the one-time implementation credit? I'm trying to keep the economics tight but give ScoutAI the runway they requested. If we agree, I’ll send the redline-ready MAP and a short Spot vs Commit spreadsheet showing net unit economics by tier.

Thanks —
Naomi

On Wed, Aug 26, 2026 at 11:02 AM Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@scoutai.com> wrote:

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Fri, 28 Aug 2026 10:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pulse plan: TPM ramp & MAP draft for ScoutAI

Naomi —

I reviewed the numbers. Two quick internal suggestions: 

- Approve the 12% / 18% tiering as proposed; it maps well to our cost inflection points.
- Offer a one-time deployment credit equivalent to 1 month of the month-1 committed spend (in addition to the 10% implementation credit) to help close faster. This can be applied as a one-off invoice credit and de-risks the first month for ScoutAI.

If we do both credits we should require the DocuSign to be completed by Sept 10 and an internal finance checkpoint to confirm ARR recognition treatment. Karthik — can you check the accounting treatment and confirm whether we need any paperwork?

Ben
VP, Sales Operations
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com

Naomi / Ben / team —

Thanks — the revised MAP aligns with our internal direction. Procurement will accept the two-tier discount and the temporary overage cap as long as the additional deployment credit is documented in the SOW. We can sign the MAP and SOW by Sept 9 if Redwood adds a short SOW paragraph describing the deployment credit application mechanics (invoice credit, non-refundable after issuance).

We also reviewed the onboarding milestones and the KV warmup checklist — engineering is comfortable with the 2-week window as long as there is a short readiness call during week 1.

Next steps from our side: I’ll route the MAP to Procurement and Ellen for legal review. Please send the redline-ready MAP + SOW paragraph and the DocuSign link; once those are in, Procurement will aim to return a countersigned copy within 48 hours.

Liam
